name: L&T Finance Ltd
description: L&T Finance Ltd (LTF) is a specialized non-banking financial institution operating in retail credit, housing finance, and asset-backed financing. The enterprise focuses on delivering accessible home loans, loan against property (LAP), and affordable housing financing across Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3 Indian cities.

revenue_breakup.desc: Individual housing credit for salaried and self-employed residential property buyers.

Project construction funding for residential real estate developments.

Extensive branch network deeply embedded in high-growth suburban and Tier-2 mortgage corridors.
Diversified funding access across bank term loans, NCDs, commercial paper, and NHB refinance.

bullish_triggers: Government push for affordable urban housing (PMAY subsidies) driving primary mortgage originations.
Strong residential real estate sales velocity in Tier-1 and Tier-2 metros.
bearish_risks: Sharp increase in wholesale borrowing costs narrowing net interest spreads.
Aggressive mortgage rate competition from top private and public sector commercial banks.
